package practiceruntime

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (c Client) ReadExecutionProjection(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.PracticeExecutionProjection, error) {
	if c.BaseURL == "" || c.InternalToken == "" {
		return domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{}, errors.New("practice runtime unavailable")
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/v2/task-instances/"+url.PathEscape(instanceID)+"/execution-projection?student_id="+url.QueryEscape(studentID), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{}, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
	}
	response, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{}, errors.New("practice execution projection unavailable")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 32769))
	if err != nil || len(data) > 32768 {
		return domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{}, errors.New("practice execution projection exceeds bound")
	}
	var result domain.PracticeExecutionProjection
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err = decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return result, errors.New("invalid projection JSON")
	}
	return result, nil
}
